newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bonino amazed at reports of salmon price row.
newsitem.headline: Bonino amazed at reports of salmon price row.

text.p: Fisheries Commissioner Emma Bonino said on Tuesday she was amazed at press reports about a row with Britain over salmon minimum import prices.
Scottish Fisheries Minister Raymond Robertson was quoted as saying after talks with Bonino on Friday that he was "angry" and the victim of "insulting treatment."
"There can be no 'insulting treatment' in duly arguing the merits of one's case, and assuming responsibility for it, however sensitive the economic interests at stake," Bonino said in a statement.
The Commission believes the imposition of a minimimum import price for salmon is not warranted given the relative stability of prices.
The recent appreciation of the pound may have added to the difficulties of the Scottish industry but that was not the result of unfair market forces, it said.
"If in any way insult is added to injury in this case, this is the fact of making the Commission, once again, the scapegoat for national tensions and political quarrels," Bonino added.
The vast majority of the EU fish processing industry, including some Scottish factories, opposes minimum import prices, the Commission noted.
